subject: Quick question about choosing slice instead of RW

messages.author: 9c2c0c89a3d22b1b
messages.subject: Quick question about choosing slice instead of RW
parts:
Dear Nimble devs & users,

I my applications of Nimble I've noticed that using the slice sampler instead of the RW, on univariate nodes, leads to a better ratio of Effective Sample Size/time.

At present I'm therefore implementing a step like the following after configureMCMC():

targetslist <- sapply(confnimble$getSamplers(), function(xx)xx$target)
nameslist <- sapply(confnimble$getSamplers(), function(xx)xx$name)
for(asampler in targetslist[nameslist == 'RW']){
confnimble$removeSamplers(asampler)
confnimble$addSampler(target=asampler, type='slice')
}


It works, although I must be careful afterwards about the consequent change in sampling order. However, this replacement seems very slow when it has to be done for thousands of nodes.

Could you possibly suggest a more efficient method, or even better a way to let Nimble choose "slice" as the fallback sampler instead of the RW? For my particular code it would make sense because I know that all RW nodes will be univariate.

Cheers!
Luca

messages.author: f116cbe5c604c988
messages.subject: Re: Quick question about choosing slice instead of RW
parts:
Luca, the direct approach is simply to provide the argument onlySlice = TRUE to configureMCMC.  I think that should take care of what you're trying to do.

Cheers,
Daniel

messages.author: f116cbe5c604c988
messages.subject: Re: Quick question about choosing slice instead of RW
parts:
Luca, this is how I would go about it, although I'm not certain it will be worlds faster than the code you sketched out:

samplerConfs <- confnimble$getSamplers()
RWbool <- sapply(samplerConfs, `[[`, 'name') == 'RW'
RWtargets <- sapply(samplerConfs[RWbool], `[[`, 'target')
confnimble$replaceSamplers(RWtargets, type = 'slice', expandTarget = TRUE)

Depending on the version of nimble you're using, the replaceSamplers() method may or may not be available, but I wanted to put in a plug for it anyway.

And you're right: in my mind, I thought that using onlySlice = TRUE would still assign conjugate samplers when possible (thus only replacing default RW samplers with slice samplers, as you wanted), but you're entirely correct, that's not how it operates.  It makes me wonder if an additional argument (sliceAsDefault, or similar) would be in order.

Let me know if this approach is still too slow for you, or how it works.

Cheers,
Daniel

Thank you again, Daniel!

Right, I saw the 'replaceSamplers' (plural) method in the help pages, and I tried it but it doesn't seem to work for me with Nimble 0.13.2. It throws the error

"invalid 'type' (list) of argument"

Thank you for the suggestions though; you don't need to spend further time on this, I can simply live with it.

At the moment the onlySlice option replaces all univariate conjugate samplers, but doesn't touch the multivariate ones. A "sliceAsDefault" option will be very welcome! :)

Always grateful,
Luca
